profile.headline: Software Engineer specializing in security, upgrades, and risk reduction in legacy systems
profile.summary:
I’ve always loved solving problems through technology. Over the past 5 years, I’ve grown into a software engineer focused on Ruby and Ruby on Rails upgrades, technical debt remediation, and building reliable, maintainable systems. 

While working in consulting, I became fascinated by security, especially after using tools like Brakeman and bundler-audit to uncover vulnerabilities. That experience inspired me to explore how software can be made more secure from the start, and I’m now excited about how I can combine my development experience with my passion for security and building tools that make software safer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led Ruby on Rails, Ruby, and Node.js upgrades across multiple production systems, improving framework compatibility, performance, and long-term maintainability for clients.
	•	Performed in-depth codebase audits using RubyCritic, Skunk, Brakeman, and bundler-audit to detect performance bottlenecks, outdated dependencies, and security vulnerabilities; provided targeted remediation strategies to clients.
	•	Built an extension of a university’s payment system to automate the hiring and payroll process for summer research staff, replacing an outdated manual workflow.
	•	Played a key role in redesigning the company’s internal Rails upgrade process, creating clearer documentation and improving efficiency for engineering teams.
	•	Authored and published technical blog posts on Ruby and Rails upgrade strategies and best practices; several were featured in Ruby Weekly, expanding the company’s reach and reputation in the Ruby community.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, JavaScript and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed responsive WordPress websites, optimizing cross-browser and mobile compatibility.
• Re-engaged by a former employer to assist with the completion of a large-scale brand refresh project, delivering under tight deadlines.
•  Developed and tested prototype full-stack web applications using Ruby on Rails and Sinatra, implementing unit tests to ensure code reliability.
•  Built responsive single-page applications with React and third-party APIs to explore and validate new product concepts.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Led front-end development for bayada.com, its HubSpot blog, and related marketing web properties for a leading home healthcare organization.
• Took full ownership of front-end development after team restructuring, managing design implementation, deployment, and maintenance independently.
• Designed and built a high-traffic contest platform that automated manual workflows for marketing teams, significantly improving operational efficiency.
• Developed responsive, mobile-first templates and a component-based UI library to unify branding and accelerate web development across properties.
• Built custom HubSpot CMS themes and Bootstrap-based landing pages to support large-scale marketing and recruiting campaigns.

positions.title: Communications Assistant
positions.description:
•  Joined the Institutional Advancement team in a temporary role to assist web manager and editor in the regular maintenance of the Academy’s blog and website.
• Featured as a guest writer for the Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University’s blog.
• Published in the Summer 2015 edition of 'Academy Frontiers', a quarterly magazine for members of the Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University.

honors.title: Summer of Open Source Fellowship
honors.description: Was selected as one of twelve fellows for Girl Develop It's pilot program to encourage more women to contribute to open source projects and to serve as leaders in the open source community.
honors.issuer: Issued by Girl Develop It · Aug 2014

honors.title: Philadelphia Mayor's Scholarship Program
honors.description: Was selected by the Mayor's Scholarship Committee - through the University of Pennsylvania and the City of Philadelphia, for a special financial aid program that meets 100% of a student's needs.
honors.issuer: Issued by City of Philadelphia · Sep 2006
